pr_title: chore: allow force reload in traceviewer/watch mode
pr_body:
According to the [spec](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#navigator-service-worker-controller) if a user does a force refresh, navigator.serviceWorker.controller is `null` which is why it was hanging before. So we need to first unregister the SW and the register a new one to be controlled and have access to a SW.

Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/22097

issue_context.title: [BUG] Using CMD + SHIFT + R in UI Mode makes it blank
issue_context.body:

### System info
- Playwright Version: [v1.32.1]
- Operating System: [macOS 13.2.1]
- Other info: UI Mode

**Steps**
- Open UI Mode
- Press CMD + SHIFT + R

**Expected**

CMD + R reloads the UI Mode. CMD + SHIFT + R should reload it too

**Actual**

UI Mode becomes blank.
![Image 30-03-2023 at 15 06](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23238398/228845413-ae98bbf6-ae36-45a8-bd4b-6336e88d4369.jpg)
comments:
Investigation:

Issue is that `navigator.serviceWorker.controller` is null after a force reload, we could [unregister and re-register](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/9aaf2b028e233dde3c04e901e67a4cc9bf4ffce8/packages/trace-viewer/src/watch.tsx#L30-L34) which would work. We have the same issue for normal trace viewer.

review_comments: I believe this construct was used for a reason.
